author: resepignev
body:
IGN:
Caiiden

Reason for temp-ban:
Please be respectful and appropriate in chat

Reason for Unban:
I think I should be unbanned from the Avicus Network as when I was "being rude" in chat, I wasn't warned directly. I also was being rude to friends and they knew that it was only banter as they would play along with me. I did tell Zintenka sorry for the rudeness and thanks for putting up with the banter (as he was the only person I was actually rude for because I thought he meant he would boot me and BlueFoundation offline) before I was banned. I don't think I deserve a ban as I was least vulgar and/or rude. BlueFoundation and Munte were being far more vulgar/rude in chat than me. If this ban doesn't get appealed, consider a shortened length of the ban please. A 5 day ban is a bit excessive considering my actions. Thank you for your time.

Note: Submitting the appeal because Caiiden can't access the forums, since there are problems with his internet provider. And he asked me in TS, I told him to send me his answers for the guideline over skype.

replies.body:
Hello,

You didn't get a warn due too the fact that you have more infractions that relate to disrespect/vulgarity in chat. I honestly think that you're luck it was only 5 days, this appeal is denied.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
